name: Broken rice
summary: Cơm tấm in Châu Đốc is the broken-rice plate VnExpress tells you to eat on Lê Lợi, Thủ Khoa Huân, and around Chợ Châu Đốc. The plate is sườn, bì, and chả, with sweet-sour fish sauce. The local pickle plate adds mustard greens beside the usual daikon. Ho Chi Minh City’s cơm tấm is a different account.
origin: A Mekong plate, on VnExpress, 2 Oct 2019. The same article places the Châu Đốc version on those three walks. Sơn Nam, quoted in the English edition of 12 Oct 2019, called broken rice a working meal of the delta whose broken grains stayed the base.
howToEat: VnExpress serves it with sweet-sour fish sauce and grilled pork. Breakfast is the meal named for a filling plate.
The usual side is pickled daikon. In Châu Đốc the same article adds pickled mustard greens.
The English edition also names bi, shredded pork skin, and chả as toppings, with scallion fat and pickled daikon and carrot.
A plate of sườn bì chả was printed at 25,000–30,000 VND on 2 Oct 2019. That is one article’s figure. Check on arrival.
where: Along Lê Lợi, along Thủ Khoa Huân, and around Chợ Châu Đốc. A shop was not singled out.
seoDescription: Cơm tấm in Châu Đốc is broken rice with grilled pork on Lê Lợi, Thủ Khoa Huân, and around the market. VnExpress adds pickled mustard greens. Check on arrival for the price.
